headline: Not in Jakarta, Many Banks Collapse in This Region
summary: Indonesia's financial services authority OJK has shut 17 people's credit banks, known as BPRs, through November 2026, mostly outside Jakarta.
why: The OJK is Indonesia's financial regulator, and bank closures affect depositor confidence and the stability of the local lending system.
original_headline: Bukan di Jakarta, Bank Banyak Tumbang di Daerah Ini
